rubric.type: Internal editorial visual-craft judgment from 1 to 5, subordinate to actual acceptance. Decimals distinguish observed repair priorities, not clinical measurement.
rubric.4: Good review art with visible correctable defects.
rubric.4.9: Near-final visual craft after independent reinspection; external acceptance separate.
rubric.5: No observed defect under inspection; never inferred from machine checks.

limitations: Scores are subjective internal visual-craft judgments for explicitly listed objects. They are not clinical measurements, master-audit satisfaction, qualified SLP approval, owner/child acceptance or physical-print approval.
